verdict.rationale: skills.sh/vercel-labs/skills is a CLI package manager for distributing 'skills' (SKILL.md files) into various coding agents; no evidence anywhere in the pack mentions an MCP server, MCP endpoint, or MCP-based connection method. Since skills.sh is not itself an agent but a tool/registry, this axis is a fair question, and its complete absence in the docs/CLI reference/community threads means no support is evidenced.
